Retrying durable commands

A durable command records the product transition and its queue operation in one transaction. Callers submit intent and receive a stable result; they do not manage transaction handles.

Requirements

  • Use a stable idempotency key.
  • Lock multiple records in deterministic key order.
  • Return a classified error for conflicts.

Example

result, err := commands.Submit(ctx, SubmitCommand{LinkID: id})
if errors.Is(err, ErrConflict) { return retryLater }

Retry the whole command after an ambiguous transport failure. The adapter will observe the existing idempotency key and return the committed result.
